fluff.overview: Com Guard conventional infantry benefit from ComStar's access to preserved Star League technology, fielding weapons and equipment that match or exceed the standard issue of any Inner Sphere military, backed by the institutional discipline of the secular Order's professional military culture. Mechanized wheeled Level I formations use wheeled APCs that provide a balance of road speed, infantry protection, and maintenance economy. The Com Guards deploy wheeled mechanized infantry extensively for garrison and patrol duties on worlds with developed transportation networks. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
